title: President Joe Biden tours downtown Mayfield after Tornado Damage B-roll
description: MAYFIELD, KY - December 15, 2021 -B-roll of  President Joe Biden walks through downtown Mayfield, KY with Secretary of FEMA Administrator Deanne Criswell, Homeland Security Alejandro Mayorkas, Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear, Rep. James Comer, Mayor Kathy Stewart O'Nan to review the devastation to the Kentucky community by recent tornadoes. FEMA video / Dominick Del Vecchio
keywords: President Biden, Kentucky Tornado, EM3575, DR4630, Dawson Springs
